physics-killer-09.title: Newton nia Lei sira kona-ba Movimentu no Relatividade Espesiál
physics-killer-09.topic: Newton nia Lei sira kona-ba Movimentu no Relatividade Espesiál
physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-09.material: Iha reasaun fuzaun nuklear $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ masa partíkula sira mak $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutrón: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Enerjia nebé korresponde ba $1\,\mathrm{u}$ mak $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, no enerjia sinétika partíkula sira molok reasaun ignora. Pár saida mak loos hatudu enerjia $E$ nebé libera iha reasaun ne’e no enerjia sinétika neutrón bainhira aproksima katak $\mathrm{^4He}$ nebé forma no neutrón iha momentu linear hanesan no rasaun masa $4:1$, tuir sekuénsia?
physics-killer-09.thinking.0: Newton nia Lei sira kona-ba Movimentu no Relatividade Espesiál
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Iha reasaun fuzaun nuklear $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ masa partíkula sira mak $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutrón: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Enerjia nebé korresponde ba $1\,\mathrm{u}$ mak $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, no enerjia sinétika partíkula sira molok reasaun ignora. Pár saida mak loos hatudu enerjia $E$ nebé libera iha reasaun ne’e no enerjia sinétika neutrón bainhira aproksima katak $\mathrm{^4He}$ nebé forma no neutrón iha momentu linear hanesan no rasaun masa $4:1$, tuir sekuénsia?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$, tanba nee $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Tanba partíkula rua depois reasaun iha momentu linear hanesan, $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ no $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Tanba nee $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Se aplika proporsionalidade invérsa masa ba kotuk, hetan $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (resposta sala ②); se fahe enerjia ba metade, mak resposta sala ③; se kalkula sala $\Delta m$ nu’udar $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$, mak resposta sala ④.
physics-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-09.s.s1.hint.0: Defeitu masa $\Delta m=($ soma masa molok reasaun $)-($ soma masa depois reasaun $)$, enerjia nebé libera $E=\Delta m\,c^2$. Se intensidade momentu linear hanesan, $K=p^2/(2m)$, tanba nee enerjia sinétika invérsa proporsionál ba masa.
